# Popout Authenticator

> A 2FA authenticator browser extension that makes TOTP/HOTP codes locally, keeps accounts in an encrypted vault on your device, and fills codes into the sign-in pages you allow. Open source (MIT).

Popout Authenticator opens your codes in the toolbar popup, a separate window, or the side panel. It has no account limits, no sign-up, no analytics, no ads, and no developer server. Accounts are stored in a vault encrypted with AES-256-GCM; a password lock protects the vault key with Argon2id, and optional passkey unlock is available (not in Firefox). You can add accounts from QR codes, otpauth:// links, typed secrets, or imported backups, and back up or sync them with encrypted files and your browser's own sync. It builds on the MIT-licensed code of the original Authenticator extension. Current version: 1.0.4.

Supported browsers: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Whale, and Safari (macOS only, no iOS version).

## Install

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/nakgmloofpboegibcjhainbpjjokmbgj): Chrome
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/edipphpgdmfabonchodjfnejlbjoknhh): Edge
- [Firefox Add-ons (AMO)](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/popout-authenticator/): Firefox
- [Naver Whale Store](https://store.whale.naver.com/detail/bcfobdldplagmohdgaiocjddlokiolgc): Whale
- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823010294): Safari on macOS

## Overview

- [Home](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/): What it does, features, privacy, and limits
- [All guides](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/): Index of step-by-step guides

## Guides

- [Get started](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/getting-started/): Install and add your first account from a QR code, a link, or by typing the secret
- [Popup, window, and side panel](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/open-and-organize/): Open codes in three views and keep a long list tidy with search, groups, and pins
- [Fill codes into sign-in pages](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/fill-codes/): Fill a code with one click, the right-click menu, a shortcut, or a button next to the field
- [Site match check](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/site-match-check/): How Popout compares the page with the site addresses saved for an account, and what it asks on any other address
- [Is a browser extension safe for 2FA codes?](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/how-secrets-are-stored/): Where Popout keeps secret keys, how they are encrypted, what leaves the extension, which permissions it asks for, and what it cannot protect against
- [Lock and protect your accounts](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/lock-and-protect/): Password lock, recovery code, passkey unlock, auto-lock, and hiding codes while sharing your screen
- [Backup, export, and sync](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/backup-and-sync/): Encrypted backups, exports, recovery snapshots, the trash, and browser sync between devices
- [Share a code with a link](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/share-codes/): A link that shows an account's codes for a limited time and never contains the secret
- [Temporary 2FA sharing for small teams](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/temporary-2fa-sharing-for-teams/): Personal access, a shared vault, or a temporary code link, and what the link cannot do
- [Troubleshooting](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/troubleshooting/): Rejected codes, filling that does not work, a vault that will not unlock, and failed imports
- [IT admin deployment](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/managed-deployment/): Force-install and managed policy keys for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox

## Moving from another app

- [From the original Authenticator extension](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/from-authenticator-extension/): Import its backup file directly
- [From Authy Desktop and other apps](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/from-authy-and-other-apps/): Bring accounts from Authy Desktop, Google Authenticator, and other authenticator apps
- [Google Authenticator to your PC browser](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/google-authenticator-to-pc-browser/): Export QR codes on your phone and read them into Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Whale
- [Browser 2FA extensions compared](https://elitekid.github.io/popout-authenticator/guides/compare-browser-authenticators/): Popout Authenticator, Authenticator, 2FAS, and 2FA Authenticator side by side, checked November 23, 2026
